name: ETHSkills

install_commands.codex: Add to AGENTS.md in repo root

purpose: End-to-end Ethereum development knowledge pack — from dApp idea to production deployment, including security audit, testing, orchestration, and QA as a separate reviewer agent task.
staleness_reason: URL-based delivery means content can be updated transparently, which is good for freshness. However, the 'gas/SKILL.md' endpoint references current gas prices which are inherently stale without real-time data backing.

sub_skills.name: Ship
sub_skills.purpose: End-to-end guide from dApp idea to deployed production app. Load FIRST before any Ethereum development.

sub_skills.name: Why Ethereum
sub_skills.purpose: Why to build on Ethereum — Pectra/Fusaka upgrades, use case matching, countering stale FUD.

sub_skills.name: Orchestration
sub_skills.purpose: Three-phase build system and dApp orchestration patterns for AI agents.

sub_skills.name: Security
sub_skills.purpose: Solidity security patterns — reentrancy, oracle manipulation, vault attacks, pre-deploy checklist.

sub_skills.name: Audit
sub_skills.purpose: 500+ checklist items across 19 domains — AMM, lending, oracles, proxies, bridges.

sub_skills.name: QA
sub_skills.purpose: Production QA checklist — intended for a separate reviewer agent, not the build agent.

sub_skills.name: Testing
sub_skills.purpose: Foundry unit tests, fuzz testing, fork testing, invariant testing.

sub_skills.name: Standards
sub_skills.purpose: ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, ERC-8004 (agent identity), EIP-7702 (smart EOAs).

sub_skills.name: Layer 2s
sub_skills.purpose: Current L2 landscape, bridging, deployment differences, when to use which.

sub_skills.name: Indexing
sub_skills.purpose: Reading onchain data — events, The Graph, Dune, why you can't loop blocks.

sub_skills.name: Frontend UX
sub_skills.purpose: Scaffold-ETH 2 rules — button loaders, approval flow, USD values.

sub_skills.name: Frontend Playbook
sub_skills.purpose: Full build-to-production — fork mode, IPFS, Vercel, ENS subdomain, go-live checklist.

sub_skills.name: Gas & Costs
sub_skills.purpose: Current gas prices, real costs today, mainnet vs L2 honest comparison.

sub_skills.name: Wallets
sub_skills.purpose: Wallet creation, dApp connection, signing, multisig (Gnosis Safe), account abstraction.

sub_skills.name: Tools
sub_skills.purpose: Foundry, Scaffold-ETH 2, x402 HTTP payments, MCPs, abi.ninja, RPCs.

sub_skills.name: Money Legos
sub_skills.purpose: DeFi composability — Uniswap, Aave, Compound, MakerDAO, Yearn, Curve.

sub_skills.name: Noir (ZK Privacy)
sub_skills.purpose: ZK privacy apps with Noir — circuits, Solidity verifiers, NoirJS frontend.

sub_skills.name: Contract Addresses
sub_skills.purpose: Verified contract addresses for major protocols across mainnet and L2s.

sub_skills.name: Concepts
sub_skills.purpose: Core mental models — 'nothing is automatic,' incentive design, hyperstructure test.

sub_skills.name: Protocol
sub_skills.purpose: EIP lifecycle, fork process, how to verify what's actually planned.
